Asha Rao: FYI product demo today called out a confusing cost card: "Projected savings: -15%" but billing forecast shows -1%. They asked why the Console "what-if" slider seems optimistic.
Tom Bennett: Most of these come from three hidden assumptions: short amortization window for transcode, optimistic batch_profile, and assumed warmed KV cache. Console defaults have been 'fast-preview' for years.
Samir Patel: We added metadata to the preview API months ago to make these explicit. Payload looks like:
POST /api/cost_preview
{ mode: "amortized"|"marginal", amortization_days: int, batch_profile: "aggressive|observed|conservative", kv_hit_rate: float, sample_rate: float }
Clara M.: The problem is Console only surfaces the slider and not the metadata. Product expects numbers closer to billing baseline. We need a safe UX change.
Asha Rao: Proposal: change Console defaults to billing-aligned assumptions: amortization_days=30, batch_profile=observed, kv_hit_rate derived from sampled telemetry, sample_rate shown. Then add an "Advanced assumptions" panel that lets power users toggle aggressive options.
Tom Bennett: +1. Also add a compact "Assumption diff" header: "amort=7d -> 30d | batch=aggressive -> observed | kv=0.8 -> 0.45" so owners see drivers immediately.
Samir Patel: And return a drivers breakdown from API: a CSV-like string "batch:+12%,kv:-3%,amort:+14%" and a confidence_band key Low|Medium|High. Console can render that under the estimate.
Clara M.: We should surface sample_rate prominently. If billing ingest is 1% sampled but preview uses synthetic full traces, numbers will diverge. Show badge: "sampled telemetry: 1%" with tooltip.
Asha Rao: UX safety: when users flip to non-defaults (marginal or aggressive profiles) show a red inline banner: "Estimates exclude amortization and assume warmed caches. Do not rely for billing."
Tom Bennett: QA asks for a regression: run a sample of 100 routes, compute preview with billing defaults and run chargeback sim; assert median diff < 5%. I'll file INF-8234.
clair-bot: New ticket INF-8234 created: "preview->chargeback parity test + console assumption exposer" assigned to @Tom Bennett.
Samir Patel: Implementation tasks: 1) backend: add metadata keys drivers, confidence_band, estimation_horizon_label; 2) console: header diff + sample_rate badge + advanced panel + red banner; 3) docs: page explaining amortization math and batch profiling.
Asha Rao: I'll own product copy and UX mock; Tom + Samir please coordinate on API shape. Clara please add telemetry mapping for kv_hit_rate sampling.
Clara M.: On it. I'll add a unit-test to feed sampled traces into preview and verify the drivers string.
Asha Rao: Thanks team. If we can get a quick patch for the demo (show header diff + badge) that would salvage the meeting.
Tom Bennett: Will push a conservative UI patch to hide the aggressive defaults and show the diff header. PR incoming.
clair-bot: New PR opened: https://redwood.internal/pulls/4999 "console: expose preview assumption diff + sample badge" by Tom Bennett.
Asha Rao: Perfect. Follow-ups after demo: track adoption and any support tickets from customers who relied on fast-preview.
